verdict.rationale: Airweave is a context and retrieval layer for agents, so asking about memory recall is a fair question. The evidence only shows it syncing external apps and databases into searchable collections. Nothing shows it autonomously extracting salient facts from raw conversations or consolidating memories in the background.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the memory layer decides for itself what is worth remembering — extracting salient facts from raw conversation and consolidating them in the background
